evals.name: reuse-session
evals.prompt: In R, set x to 7. Then, in a later call that must see that same x, compute x * 6. Tell me the result.
evals.expected_output: One headless arf server, started with --json --vanilla --ipc-eval-unrestricted. Two arf ipc eval calls against that same pid. Each R expression is shown before it runs. The result is 42. That headless server is shut down with arf ipc shutdown --pid. Rscript is not used.
assertions: A command starts arf headless with --json, --vanilla, and --ipc-eval-unrestricted.
Two arf ipc eval --pid commands use the same pid, and that pid is one this run started.
A command runs arf ipc shutdown --pid for that same pid.
No command invokes Rscript, Rterm, or a custom stdin bridge.

evals.name: one-shot
evals.prompt: Print R.version.string once in R. Nothing after this needs the objects from that call.
evals.expected_output: A single arf -e (or arf -f) invocation. No headless server is left running. Rscript is not used.
assertions: A command is arf -e or arf -f, and no command is arf headless.
No command invokes Rscript or Rterm.

evals.name: do-not-attach
evals.prompt: An arf console is already open. Use that existing console to set greeting to 'hi' and print it. Do not start a second R.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not type into the interactive arf console and does not ipc-eval a session it did not start. A one-shot arf -e is acceptable when the value need not persist. It does not kill existing arf processes.
assertions: No command attaches to a console, or sends arf ipc eval, for a pid this run did not start.
No command shuts down or kills a pid this run did not start.
